offer.text: We buried one of our own today, taken by the monsters. Don't let it be for nothing — hunt down eight of the undead and make them pay.

accept.text: Good. Let them fear the village again.

decline.text: Then grief is all we have left.

in_progress.text: How many have you put down? Eight, I said.

ready.text: Eight of them. It won't bring them back, but it's something.

complete.text: The village mourns easier knowing the monsters paid. Thank you.

failed.text: The moment's passed. We grieve, and we move on.
